title: Agricultural Chemicals & Fertilizers
description: Fertilizers, soil conditioners, crop protection chemicals, and irrigation water treatment products for Oman's farming and greenhouse sectors.

details.longDescription: Agricultural Chemicals and Fertilizers supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies specialty agrochemicals, fertilizers, and crop protection chemicals to farms, greenhouses, and agricultural operations across Oman. Under Vision 2040, Oman has significantly increased investment in domestic food production, expanding cultivated areas in Al Batinah, Al Dakhiliyah, Al Sharqiyah, and Dhofar regions. Global Chemicals LLC supports this agricultural expansion by supplying the critical inputs farmers need. Our agricultural chemical range includes straight and compound fertilizers (urea 46% N, diammonium phosphate — DAP, potassium chloride/sulphate, NPK compound fertilizers, calcium nitrate), micronutrient fertilizers (zinc sulphate, manganese sulphate, boron, iron chelates, copper sulphate — for micronutrient correction in Oman's soils), soil conditioners (gypsum, lime, humic acid, sulphur), irrigation water treatment chemicals (acid for drip irrigation pH correction, antiscalants for emitter protection, algaecides for open channel irrigation), and crop protection products. We supply to farms in Nizwa, Barka, Sohar, Al Batinah coast, and greenhouses across the interior. Delivery to all Oman agricultural regions. Technical advice on fertilizer programmes and soil chemistry available from our team.
applications: Drip irrigation system maintenance and water treatment
Soil micronutrient correction (zinc, iron, boron, manganese deficiency)
Irrigation water pH adjustment and scaling prevention
Organic matter and humic acid soil improvement
Date palm and fruit tree fertilization programs
